brief: A fall backwards from the guard that passes the Breakfall check: sink, sit back, roll onto the back with the chin tucked and the arms slapping the floor.
notes: The Breakfall check (scripts/breakfall.gd) is the judge: head clear of the floor, chin tucked, arm not locked, the landing spread over arm / back / hip, the first touch under 2.5 m/s. 30 fps.

asserts.line: pelvis speed under 3 m/s all clip
